svg.title: Holding a heavy capacitor down: a bracket, or a cable tie
svg.desc: Drawn to scale except the board, side views of a 16 mm capacitor on a board, twice. Left: a hold-down bracket fits over the capacitor and is screwed through the board, with nuts underneath. Right: the capacitor lies on its side and a cable tie passes through two holes in the board and round it. In both, the hold-down, not the solder joints, carries the part's weight under vibration.

g.text: Screw through the board, nut beneath
Through two holes in the board
Drawn to scale except the board thickness.
Fit the bracket or tie before the part
